name: Trinidad and Tobago

flag.description: A red field with a white-edged black diagonal band running from the upper hoist to the lower fly.
flag.symbolism: Red represents the vitality of the land and people and the warmth of the sun, black the strength and dedication of the people, and white the sea and equality.

hook: Trinidad and Tobago: one white-edged black slash across solid red, with no stars, unlike the diagonal of Saint Kitts and Nevis.
trivia: The steelpan, made from oil drums, was developed in Trinidad and is the national instrument.
Pitch Lake in Trinidad is the largest natural deposit of asphalt in the world.
